name: Defenders (Classic)
description: The non-team team—Doctor Strange, Hulk, Namor, and other misfits who never wanted to be Avengers—assembles when threats too strange for conventional heroes emerge. Disorganized but devastatingly powerful.
flavorText: We're not a team. We just keep ending up in the same room.
musicAIPrompt: Create a 45-second seamless loopable orchestral film score in the exact style of John Williams. Friendship / Bonding Theme. Misfit non-team Defenders assembling. Warm quirky strings with heroic but slightly off-kilter brass. Nostalgic and powerful, wide stereo, instrumental only, perfectly loopable with no fade in/out.
